planets.name: Kepler-93 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-93 with a 4.73-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-93 b was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-93. Its orbit and size follow Bonomo et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONOMO_ET_AL_2023): disc_year 2014, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 4.72674002, pl_radj 0.13185856, pl_bmassj 0.014662

quotes.title: Kepler-93b
quotes.card: Kepler-93b (KOI-69b) is a hot, dense transiting Super-Earth exoplanet located approximately 313 light-years away in the constellation of Lyra, orbiting the G-type star Kepler-93.
quotes.introduction: Its discovery was announced in February 2014 by American astronomer Geoffrey Marcy and his team.
